messages:
devon: Heads-up — noticed a spike in fncall validation rejects this morning. They show up as invoke.failed in raw logs but the Console route breakdown isn't attributing them to routes, so our per-route QPS and quota UI looks off. Repro sample added below.

anna: ugh, can you paste an example event? is this new after the strict schema roll? :eyes:

devon: pasted a sanitized event:```json
{"event":"fncall_reject","route_id":null,"model":"gpt-redwood-4x","reason":"schema_mismatch","validator":"strict-v2","user_id":"acct-123","timestamp":1746500000}```

anna: ah, route_id is null — probably coming from the proxy where we short-circuit before route binding. That would explain why console drops attribution.

mike: billing question — do we treat schema_mismatch as billable invoke or a client error? current pipeline marks it as failed invoke and it increments invoke counts which ups billed tokens. We need a policy.

lia (pm): From product POV we should: 1) show validation rejects as their own line in Console (so customers can see quality rejections), 2) not bill for zero-output rejects if we never entered the model runtime. But we need to be careful about edge cases.

tomas: Data suggestion: keep the raw event but add derived fields in ingestion: attributed_route (fallback to routing_policy.route_hint or model when route_id missing) and validation_phase boolean. Retain validation events for 90 days with higher sampling for first 72 hours after deploy. That gives us debugging signals without exploding storage.

devon: Implementation note: ingest-bot currently emits an enriched event after routing; these rejects come earlier. We can patch ingest to emit a pre-routing event to the validation index with a route_hint. PR sketched here: https://stash/redwood/infra/PR-2148

mike: For billing, propose: if validator result == "schema_mismatch" and tokens_generated == 0 then mark as non-billable. We'll need a strict definition and a test matrix.

anna: UI/UX: Console should display a small warning icon next to routes with >0.5% validation rejects and include a link to examples (sanitized). Also a toggle to include/exclude validation rejects from per-route metrics.

lia (pm): +1 on toggle. Also add a rollout note: opt-in can be on by default for internal accounts, off for customers until we iterate wording.

tomas: Telemetry retention: 90 days default, 30 days for low-volume accounts, with the ability to snapshot full traces on-demand. We'll also keep a 7-day high-res buffer for sampling.

devon: Ops question — are there any risk of double-counting if we emit pre-routing validation event _and_ the later invoke.failed? Need dedupe keys (request_id + phase).

mike: yep dedupe by request_id + phase. Also add a metric for "validation_rejects_deduped" so billing uses final flags only.

ingest-bot: automated note: ingest pipeline will be paused for a 2h deploy window to land the pre-routing instrumentation. ETA 03/26 02:00 UTC.

anna: timeline? who owns the Console change?

lia (pm): console-team (anna) will own UI; eng-platform (devon + tomas) will own ingestion and routing fallback. Mike owns billing rule. I'll file a tracking ticket and coordinate rollout/comm.

devon: filing follow-up tasks now. Thanks all — will post PR links and a short playbook for oncall in the ticket. :thumbsup:
